audit_items.proof_trace: The safety check is correctly applied post-withdrawal: `withdraw_ctokens` (obligation.move:104) mutates the obligation's ctoken balance in-place, and `is_obligation_safe` (L1214-1249) immediately reads the same updated state via `ctoken_amount_by_coin`. The boundary condition (`collateral_weighted_value.ge(borrow_weight_weighted_debt_value)`) allowing equality is intentional per L1247 comment — because both sides are already weighted (collateral × CF vs. debt × BW), equality in weighted space means actual LTV < 1.0, so the position remains overcollateralized. No bypass paths exist: Grep confirms the single public entry point `withdraw_as_coin` is the only caller of `handle_withdraw`.
